description_en: Queries the resource group information of a cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBResourceGroup接口查询集群的资源组信息
name: DescribeDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: group_name

GroupsInfo.description_en: The list of resource group information

ClusterMode.description_en:
The resource group mode. Valid values:

Disable (default): Standard mode.
AutoScale: Auto scaling mode
ClusterMode.description_zh:
资源组模式，取值：

Disable（默认）：常规模式。
AutoScale：自动弹性模式

ClusterSizeResource.description_en: The resource specifications of a single cluster, in ACUs

ConnectionString.description_en:
The endpoint of the resource group.

This parameter is returned only when Engine is set to SparkWarehouse
ConnectionString.description_zh:
资源组连接地址。

仅Engine为SparkWarehouse时返回该参数

ElasticMinComputeResource.description_en: The minimum elastic computing resources, in ACUs
ElasticMinComputeResource.description_zh: 最小计算弹性资源，单位为ACU

Engine.description_en:
The resource group engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.
SparkWarehouse: SparkWarehouse engine
Engine.description_zh:
资源组引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB for MySQL引擎。
SparkWarehouse：SparkWarehouse引擎

EngineParams.description_en: The configuration parameters for Spark applications, which apply to all Spark jobs executed in this resource group. To configure parameters for a specific Spark job, you can set them in the code when submitting the job
EngineParams.description_zh: Spark应用配置参数，应用于该资源组执行的所有Spark作业。如需为某个Spark作业单独配置参数，可以在提交作业时通过代码设置

GroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group

GroupType.description_en:
The query type. Valid values:
interactive (default): Interactive query mode.
batch: Batch query mode.
Job: Offline query mode
GroupType.description_zh:
查询类型，取值说明：
interactive（默认值）：交互查询模式。
batch：分批查询模式。
Job：离线查询模式

GroupUserList.description_en: The list of database accounts bound to the resource group
GroupUserList.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号列表

items.description_en: The database account bound to the resource group
items.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号

GroupUsers.description_en: The list of database accounts bound to the resource group. Multiple accounts are separated by commas (,)
GroupUsers.description_zh: 资源组绑定的数据库账号列表，多个账号以英文逗号（,）分隔

MaxClusterCount.description_en: The maximum number of clusters that can run in the resource group. The maximum value is 10
MaxClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内最多可以运行的Cluster个数，最大为10

MaxComputeResource.description_en:
The maximum reserved computing resources, in ACUs.
If GroupType is set to Interactive, the maximum reserved computing resources are the currently unallocated resources of the cluster, with a step size of 16 ACUs.
If GroupType is set to Job, the maximum reserved computing resources are the currently unallocated resources of the cluster, with a step size of 8 ACUs
MaxComputeResource.description_zh:
最大计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8 ACU

MinClusterCount.description_en: The minimum number of clusters that must run in the resource group. The minimum value is 1
MinClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内至少需要运行的Cluster个数，最小为1

MinComputeResource.description_en:
The minimum reserved computing resources, in ACUs.
If GroupType is set to Interactive, the minimum reserved computing resources are 16 ACUs.
If GroupType is set to Job, the minimum reserved computing resources are 0 ACUs
MinComputeResource.description_zh:
最小计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0 ACU

NodeNum.description_en: The number of nodes. Each node provides 16 cores and 64 GB of resources
NodeNum.description_zh: 节点数量。1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB

Port.description_en:
The port number of the resource group.

This parameter is returned only when Engine is set to SparkWarehouse
Port.description_zh:
资源组端口号。

仅Engine为SparkWarehouse时返回该参数

RunningClusterCount.description_en: The number of running clusters in the resource group
RunningClusterCount.description_zh: 资源组内正在运行的Cluster个数

Status.description_en:
The resource group status. Valid values:
Pending: Creating.
Running: Running.
Scaling: Scaling.
Deleting: Deleting.
Deleted: Deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源组状态，取值说明：
Pending：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Scaling：变配中。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除
